The piezoelectric effect involves generating an electric charge in response to mechanical stress, and it is commonly used in crystal oscillators and filters.  
Crystal filters utilize quartz or other piezoelectric materials to achieve precise frequency selection.  
Composite filters may use multiple materials but are not defined by the piezoelectric effect.  
"m-derived" and "constant k prototype" refer to filter design methods in LC filters, not piezoelectric devices.  

Final answer: (B)
